## 4. Entry-Gate Checklist

- [ ] Charter, Agenda, and Plan references are approved and exact.
- [ ] Review and session identifiers are assigned.
- [ ] Session scope and domains are confirmed.
- [ ] RQs are validated and admitted.
- [ ] Evidence Pack is frozen and integrity-verified.
- [ ] Roles and authority boundaries are confirmed.
- [ ] Dependencies are satisfied or disclosed.
- [ ] Conflicts, access restrictions, and legal/security constraints are disclosed.
- [ ] Prior required validation is complete.
- [ ] Stop conditions are absent or bounded.

**Entry validation outcome:** `<PASS / CONDITIONAL / BLOCKED>`

**Entry validation record:** `<REFERENCE>`
